description: This file defines the EmailManTester class used for acceptance testing email configuration features in the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for navigating to email settings and populating email configuration details within the test framework.

classes.name: EmailManTester
classes.description: A class for acceptance testing email management features in SuiteCRM. It provides methods to navigate to email settings and populate email configuration fields during automated tests.

methods.name: gotoEmailSettings
methods.description: Navigates to the email settings page within the application's admin interface.

methods.name: createEmailSettings
methods.description: Fills in email configuration fields with test data, including email address, password, and other settings, to prepare the environment for email-related tests.
